articles.headline: Jim Harbaugh says he, Chargers ownership 'in this fight together' amid 0-5 start
articles.description: With the Chargers off to an 0-5 start for the first time since 2003, coach Jim Harbaugh said Monday that he and the team's ownership group are "shoulder to shoulder where we're in this fight together."

images.name: Jim Harbaugh  [600x400]
images.caption: "The way [Justin Herbert] competes, it's like few others I've ever seen," Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh said. "He's doing anything and everything week in to help us win, and I applaud those that do that."
